clientAddresses.title: Client addresses
clientAddresses.help: Meshloom runs in Docker, where every visitor may reach it through one shared address. It then limits failed sign-ins per account only. Turn this on when the address shown below is really the visitor's own (host network, or a port published without Docker's proxy): failed sign-ins are then also limited per address. Behind a reverse proxy, declare the proxy under Local configuration instead.
clientAddresses.suggest: Your connection arrives from a public address and no proxy is declared: turning this on lets Meshloom slow down an attacker per address.
clientAddresses.off: Client addresses no longer identify clients.
